raw.transcript: First, if you can, move closer to the router and see if the drops still happen, just to rule out weak signal. Next, restart everything: shut down your computer or phone, unplug the router and modem, wait about 20 seconds, then plug them back in and power your device back up. Then check the basics: make sure the Ethernet cable to the modem is snug, and if you have another cable, try swapping it. After that, log into your router’s settings and look for a channel or band option, and try switching channels, and if your device supports it, try using the 5 gigahertz band instead of 2.4. Next, update your network adapter driver or your phone or laptop’s system software, and also check if the router has a firmware update available. Finally, if the connection still drops, try a full network reset on your device, and if that doesn’t help, contact your internet provider, because the issue may be on their end.
